_comment_connection: Optional. Only needed for the SharePoint connector inventory pipeline, which writes sharepoint_list_inventory. The notebook builds sharepoint_inventory itself over Graph. Leave blank to deploy the connector pipeline as a skeleton (the rest of the stack still deploys).
_comment_graph: Service principal used by the Spark notebook to read SharePoint via Microsoft Graph (Sites.Read.All / Files.Read.All). The secret is read from Key Vault at run time; never store it here.
_comment_sites: Document libraries to migrate. scripts/Start-FabricMigration.ps1 runs PL_Migrate_Master once per entry, one after another. A pipeline run started any other way migrates the ONE library passed as SiteUrl/LibraryName/Mode; with no SiteUrl it is only a smoke test.
